# Media release-preparation receipt template

Template version: 0.1.0 · Planning aid, not a runtime contract or completed receipt.
Copy into private project storage. Keep unknown values as `unknown`; pending is
not passed. Stable project/artifact IDs come from the existing Catalog; this
template does not create or revise canonical records.

## Run and source recovery

- Project/work/recording/video IDs: unknown
- Run/checkpoint ID and captured time/timezone: unknown
- Operator; evidence origin (direct observation / supplied report / historical chat): unknown
- Aniflow/recipe revision and host/tool/model identities: unknown
- Source files: artifact ID, role, exact SHA-256, size, private locator: unknown
- Current editing project/workspace and recovery/import decision: unknown
- Missing sources or unknown historical settings: unknown
- Independent backup and restore receipt: not tested
- Creative/contributor/license/conversation evidence references and origin: unknown

| Subject | Format / streams / channels | Rational timing / frames / samples | Dimensions / color / rate | Method and evidence locator | State |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Original video | unknown | unknown | unknown | unknown | not tested |
| Original audio | unknown | unknown | unknown | unknown | not tested |

- Loudness, sample peak, true peak, dynamic-range definition and analyzer settings: unknown
- Compatibility derivative, if needed: own identity, source mapping and conversion loss: unknown
- Unsupported/unavailable measurements and reason: unknown

- Measured integrity/timing/cardinality/channel/color results: not tested

## Final identities and timestamp receipts

- Exact clean archival master IDs/hashes/locators: unknown
- Exact final destination IDs/hashes/sizes/profile version: unknown
- Fixed subject-manifest ID/hash/bytes/locator: unknown
- Manifest inventory excludes itself and its later proofs/status records: pending
- OTS subject identity; proof identity/hash/locator; client version: unknown
- OTS requested/pending/anchored/verified/failed/unavailable state: not tested
- Upgrade history, proof versions and actual attestation: unknown
- Verification time, method, node/remote trust dependency and verified existence bound: unknown
- C2PA cryptographic validation, certificate/profile validity and verifier trust: not tested
- Public certificate fingerprint/non-secret key locator, if selected: unknown
- Matching subject/proof restore and changed-byte negative check: not tested

Do not embed private keys, tokens, passwords or entire private creative records.
Do not include later proof/verification receipts in the fixed manifest they
describe. A later receipt references that immutable subject and previous proof
version; it does not rewrite a timestamped subject to record a new outcome.

## Posting package and handoff

- Destination, manual/API route and requirements URL/checked date: unknown
- Approved public titles/credits/artwork references and exact file identity: unknown
- Applicable disclosure/rights-review decision references: unknown
- Export preflight and candidate review result: pending
- Publication: not requested / not performed by preparation
- After an actual post only: URL, time, selected route and available upload receipt: unknown
- Post-upload media/metadata/watermark observations and limits: not tested
- Next bounded action, blockers and receipt needed to resume: unknown

Separate structural validity, creative quality, detector scope, provenance trust,
existence evidence and rights conclusions. Never infer one from another.
